sentences.en: He was in charge of preparing a magazine for publication.
sentences.zh: 他负责准备一份杂志进行出版。

sentences.en: But there is no publication extant authenticated with his name.
sentences.zh: 但目前没有发现有他的名字认证的手稿。

sentences.en: You can download our publications in Acrobat Portable Document Format.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Acrobat Portable Document Format 格式下下载我们的出版物。

senses.zh: 发表, 公布 - 出版, 刊行, 发行 - 出版物, 书刊
